itinerary.title: Fayoum: Karanis, Wadi El Ryan, Valley of Whales
itinerary.source: The night is spent at a Fayoum campsite, with the lights of the city absent and the sky doing what desert skies do.

itinerary.title: West to Bahariya: the oasis and its springs
itinerary.source: The night is spent in a Bahariya hotel.

itinerary.title: Into the Black and White Deserts
itinerary.source: Camp is made among them, dinner is cooked over open fire, and the desert does the rest.

itinerary.title: Breakfast at the campsite, back to Cairo
itinerary.source: The drive returns through Bahariya and back to Cairo through the afternoon, which gives the landscape time to settle in memory before the city reasserts itself.
